items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the identification of the Gysin pullback of the divisor of a meromorphic section with the first Chern class capped with the divisor class at source lines 3661-3670, label lemma-gysin-factors-general, whose proof occupies source lines 3672-3727. The proof is a local-to-global coefficient computation: the two cycles are first put into compatible normal forms along the prime divisors, with local generators chosen so that the generator of the divisor sheaf is the canonical section away from the effective divisor, then each cycle is written as a sum weighted by orders in henselized local rings, the individual summands are identified through the divisor of a regular section, and the equality is upgraded from an identity of cycles to a rational equivalence by the key formula, whose boundary terms vanish exactly at the prime divisors outside the effective divisor. The counted statement records neither the normal form nor the order computation.
